preparation_reports: Historical source-project preparation evidence. Paths in immutable old reports name that source snapshot; current runtime/corpus bindings are checked separately.
copied_probe_artifacts: Small rebuildable a100_support/build fixtures only; shared QEMU container runtime is installed under A100_PREFIX/qemu-container-runtime.
startup: zcode in project directory, /workflow for inspection, /workflow-run to start
layout: chip.md + ops/ are the inputs; a100_support/ and installed dependencies provide execution; docs/compiler-agent contains source knowledge and genuine preparation evidence only.

document_templates.adaptation: Retained working kickoff delegation, language/corpus, review, evidence and debugging instructions. Target description follows its identity/codegen/execution/numeric/tools/validation structure. initial_state: Uninitialized: no PROJECT_STATE.json, pre-created tasks, analysis deliveries or status renderings. workflow_init and task creation happen after user launch.
workflow_commit_scope: Historical preparation version; startup uses the configured workflow checkout through the zcode plugin.
version_control: Fresh Git repository for the uninitialized experiment; no development tasks or workflow state are seeded.
